MESSAGES.REGISTER_START:
Hi, I'm the blood donation center bot! To get started, please go through a quick authentication process.

First thing I'll ask for - share your contacts with me, it will greatly speed up the registration process.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_START_FAILURE: This is not your contact! Please use the button below to send your contact.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_1:
Thanks for sharing your info! Now, let's clarify some details.

First, please enter your date of birth in the format DD-MM-YYYY.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_1_FAILURE: Invalid date! Please make sure you enter it in the format DD-MM-YYYY.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_2: Great! Next, I'd like to know your gender. Please choose one of the options on the keyboard below.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_2_FAILURE: Invalid gender! Please select one of the options available on the keyboard.
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_3: Awesome! Next, I'd like you to create your personal password. Never share it, it's your key to access your personal account on the website. The password can contain numbers and letters of the Latin alphabet, at least 8 characters. Special characters are not allowed!
MESSAGES.REGISTER_STEP_3_FAILURE: Invalid password! Make sure it contains at least 8 characters, no special characters, and consists of numbers and letters of the Latin alphabet.
MESSAGES.SUCCESSFULL_REGISTER: Great! We've registered you in our system, you can now enjoy all the features!
MESSAGES.CHANGE_LANGUAGE: Choose one of the languages below...
